places.name: Gulong Gorge
places.display_name: QQ Canyon Racer mountain coaster, Gulong Gorge
places.notes: Licensed QQ Speed (Chinese kart game) themed mountain coaster: a 3.68 km descent through the mountain and forest of Gulong Gorge (古龙峡), Qingxin District, Qingyuan, with 28 turns and 9 hairpins. From a French Instagram post; figures unverified. Coordinates from OpenStreetMap (the gorge scenic area). Check minimum age and height and the operating season before planning.

sources.note: saved post in French, 17 Oct 2026: QQ Canyon Racer / Mountain Coaster, Gulong Gorge, China
